title: Submit the Portfolio and Execution Plan

blocks.title: Assemble and submit the existing work
blocks.text: Use PROGRESS Closeout: portfolio, review, ownership, gaps, roadmap, evidence, support, and sustain. Assemble retained evidence; revise only to correct a real gap. Saving workbook notes does not send files or confirm receipt.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: The reviewed intake tabletop has retained complete-input, missing-date, absent-approval, revision, and demonstration evidence. Live delivery, measured savings, real organizational permission, and certification are not established. A proposed continuation schedules a permitted bounded pilot, quality review, and conditional decision about wider use. No pilot, reviewer response, or submission receipt is invented.
